take_homes: The agent fills gaps with plausible generic text and goes easy on its own work, so I check its reports against what I know.
What the agent produces depends on what I give it, and I can save what worked in a rules file so the next session starts from it.
There is a plan-first mode that shows me the steps before the agent touches files.

misconception.why: The rules file that carries over to the next session is something agile and OKRs never gave me. The course also admitted what doesn't work (self-grading is soft, first drafts are wrong), which helped. The 'note on context' slides were the old programme again, and they pulled the other way. I'm still waiting to see Module 2.

one_line: Strip out the 'note on context' filler and there's a decent hands-on hour about not trusting the agent's own report. The filler is the agile deck again.
